lead_in: On Luke 13’s woman bent over eighteen years, Augustine counts God’s six days of creation and the Lord who made her straight.

excerpt.text: What is that woman who was in an infirmity eighteen years? In six days God finished His works. Three times six are eighteen. . . . She was bent down, she could not look up; because in vain did she hear, Up with your hearts. But the Lord made her straight.
excerpt.attribution: St Augustine, Sermon 60 on the New Testament (Ben. 110), §2, in Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, series 1, vol. 6
